I am delighted to announce the publication of our collaborative and interdisciplinary book chapter **“LIBS Imaging Applications”** in the second edition of *Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy*.

This reference book on LIBS was published by Elsevier in 2020 and edited by **Jagdish P. Singh** and **Surya N. Thakur**.

## Chapter details

**LIBS Imaging Applications**  
V. Motto-Ros, S. Moncayo, C. Fabre and B. Busser  
Pages 329–346

The chapter reviews how LIBS can be used not only for point analysis but also for **spatially resolved elemental imaging**, with applications spanning materials, geology, biology and biomedical research.

## Book details

*Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy*, 2nd edition  
Editors: Jagdish P. Singh & Surya N. Thakur  
Elsevier Science, 2020  
620 pages  
ISBN: 978-0-12-818829-3

The publication marked an important step in consolidating LIBS imaging as a field in its own right, including its emerging biomedical applications.
